summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its merger with NYIAX, Inc. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated March 18, 2026, Datavault's subsidiary merged into NYIAX, making NYIAX a wholly-owned subsidiary. Datavault issued 74,800,629 common shares as merger consideration (exchange ratio ~1.41 shares per NYIAX share) and paid ~$494,859 in cash to unaccredited investors. The filing does not state a per-share price, premium, or board recommendation. Notably, Datavault must file a resale registration statement within 30 days. If unregistered shares create overhang, monitor selling pressure and any shareholder litigation or post-merger integration risks.
